newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian party sacks secretary-general Tamirat.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian party sacks secretary-general Tamirat.

text.p: A party in Ethiopia's ruling coalition sacked its powerful secretary-general Tamirat Layne on Thursday for breaches of party discipline but it was unclear if he retained his posts of deputy prime minister and defence minister.

The Amhara National Democratic Movement (ANDM), a coalition partner of the ruling Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF), said in a statement that Tamirat had behaved contrary to the discipline of his party and no longer represented ANDM in any capacity.
It was not immediately known if Tamirat had also been sacked from his ministerial posts and parliament was meeting in an extraordinary session to discuss his fate.

"It is the strong conviction of the central committee of the ANDM that there are no grounds for Ato Tamirat, who failed to discipline himself, to discharge his responsibilites to continue with the high post in the government and as the representative of the movement in parliament",it said.
ANDM gave no further details of the disciplnary breaches.
